clips.send: A friend forwards this to someone who loves a wild Hollywood name-drop - the funniest fake resume ever read out loud, real awe.
clips.caption:
Cavett Robert, the legendary motivational speaker, introduced himself to a packed room with a bio he wrote himself - and he openly admits it.

Ghost writer for Ronald Reagan. Gag writer for Bob Hope. Romantic advisor to Elizabeth Taylor. The only authentic executor of Howard Hughes's will. Sometimes, spiritual consultant for both the Pope and the Ecumenical Council.

Kevin Trudeau says the room loved him before he said a single serious word, because he was in on the joke about his own hype.

What would your own ridiculous, over-the-top introduction say if you actually wrote it yourself?

#kevintrudeau #success #motivation #publicspeaking #mindset #selfimprovement
